name_resolution.rationale: Kew POWO accepts Anthemis cotula as a distinct species. Taiwan's Agricultural Chemicals Research Institute explicitly pairs Anthemis cotula with 臭甘菊, and the National Museum of Natural Science collection pairs it with 臭春黃菊. These independent authorities override a demonstrably conflicting TaiCOL synonym link to Eclipta prostrata/鱧腸.

warnings: TaiCOL currently links Anthemis cotula to Eclipta prostrata/鱧腸, but Kew POWO accepts Anthemis cotula as a distinct species and Taiwan government/museum sources independently name it 臭甘菊／臭春黃菊; the TaiCOL link is rejected as conflicting data.
The ACRI occurrence statement is tied to its 2002–2012 report context and is not treated as a current absence claim.
